evidence: Two equal-width waveguides enter from the left and exit on the right.
The guides are far apart at the ports, bend toward each other, run through a close central coupling region, and bend back out symmetrically.
There are no MMI slabs, rings, gratings, metal features, or crossings; the functional geometry is set by the evanescent coupling region.
topology_reasoning.operation: Optical power transfers between the two guides through the close central section. The transfer ratio is mainly controlled by guide width, central gap, effective parallel coupling length, and transition/taper shape into and out of that section.

iterations.change_made: Initial smooth symmetric two-path directional coupler. Diff showed generated waveguides moved inward too early through the S-bends, with red inner excess and blue outer missing material.

Set measured guide width/port pitch/central gap and shortened the close-coupling flat while lowering the profile exponent so the S-bend separation follows the bitmap centerline curve. Stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85.
